premises.text: People avoid trying new places because they are unsure they will like the experience
premises.evidence_span: we don't want to take the chance and try to go to a new place because we're not sure that we're going to like the experience

premises.text: SpotOn builds personalized actionable recommendations from existing Facebook and Foursquare social data
premises.evidence_span: Spot on cuts through the noise by pulling in your existing social network data from Facebook and Foursquare, uses it to build a profile of you to give you personalized and actionable recommendations

premises.text: Each place has a social layer of friends' ratings and activity, not random reviewers
premises.evidence_span: Every single place has a social layer that pulls in reasons why you should go check out a place. So, for example, seven of my friends have rated this place very highly. These are my friends. These are not random people. These are not Yelp reviewers that I don't care about

premises.text: In-app fun rating of check-ins improves personalization and creates a shared preference data layer for all users
premises.evidence_span: we make it really easy for our users to give us a lot of their preference data in a really fun and an engaging way

premises.text: Filters and search surface friend-visited places, never-been places, bookmarks, and personalized categories
premises.evidence_span: with one touch of a button, I can say, only show me places that at least one of my friends have been to, or only show me places that I've never been to

value.text: Easiest way to go to new places with friends and enjoy the end experience together
value.evidence_span: SpotOn is the easiest way to go to new places with your friends

secondary_value.text: End experience of being out with friends, not merely recommendations
secondary_value.evidence_span: Spot On is not about the recommendation. It is about the end experience of being at that bar with your friends and having a good time

causal_links.evidence_span: we're not sure that we're going to like the experience
